What NWBL does

From raw idea to structured business.

New World Business Lab helps people move from raw idea to structured business through AI-guided intake, business modeling, website and app building, marketing, compliance support, forecasting, and investor preparation.

Step 1

Discover the idea

Use AI-guided intake to uncover skills, stories, problems, markets, and business potential.

Step 2

Build the system

Turn the idea into a business model, website, campaign, compliance path, or prototype.

Step 3

Launch and grow

Use Lab Mail, Vision Pulse, Investor Path, and the wider ecosystem to reach customers and scale intelligently.

The organism map

One Lab. Many engines. One growth path.

The first build keeps the ecosystem visible while leaving room for deeper service pages, dashboards, payments, agent systems, and Codex-driven expansion later.

Build command chain

The Coding Agent Team

Every build moves through a review chain before Codex execution, ensuring structure, polish, security, accessibility, deployment readiness, and final architectural sign-off.

01

Puka Prime

Final architect and build authority. Decides what gets built.

02

ANCHOR-13

Architecture agent. Handles folder structure, component logic, and scalable system design.

03

GLASSFORGE

UI/UX agent. Handles visual polish, animations, layout, and responsiveness.

04

SHIPRIGHT

Deployment agent. Handles GitHub, Vercel, build errors, and environment setup.

05

VANTA-9

Security and risk agent. Watches for exposed keys, weak logic, unsafe permissions, and liability issues.

06

ECHO-VOW

Voice and continuity agent. Keeps copy, tone, mission, and branding consistent.

07

ADA-SENTINEL

Accessibility and compliance agent. Checks semantic HTML, contrast, forms, keyboard flow, and screen-reader safety.

08

CODEX-BRIDGE

Codex coordination agent. Turns approved plans into clean Codex and GitHub implementation tasks.
